scope: Synthetic software full-vs-reduced terminal LP comparison; no invention or physical gate
generation: Fixed initial zero. Construct saturated lower/upper ramps and independent interior mixing to generate feasible terminal. Impossible class zeros first row of B and sets target coordinate 0 to exactly 1. Other coordinates from constructed target. Matched abstract model; impossible class intentionally simple, no general infeasibility runtime claim.
warmup: Development seed 2999, horizon 8, constructed_feasible, each solver once, never included in summaries
order: alternate full/reduced first by instance ordinal plus repetition parity; calls sequential same process, no cache flush
primary: All status pairs and residuals, lower/equal/higher total-call wall time per paired repeat; retain every loss and mismatch. Expected status grounded by constructed witness or zero row, but solver infeasible is no general dual certificate.
timing_scope: Whole solver function including validation/assembly/solve/reconstruction; instance generation outside timer. No isolated solver timing, statistical superiority, or stable hardware speed claim. Shared process warm caches and OS noise uncontrolled.
summary: Per horizon/class median paired full/reduced time ratio and arithmetic mean full/reduced call seconds; retain raw repeats. Ratio >1 means full call slower. No pass/winner cutoff, no post-hoc outlier removal.
failure_rule: On exception record exception with method and repeat, continue other method/instances; include exception counts and never omit failed rows from status tables. No tuning after freeze; any change needs disclosed version. No speed ratios for failed pairs.
resources: One BLAS/OMP thread, CPU-only numpy/scipy; no downloads, training or GPU; target budget 2 cores/2 GB
